IDENTITY VERDICT - the anime 蒼天の拳 REGENESIS S2 vs the manga 蒼天の拳 リジェネシス (lane I, the I40/T30 parallel-candidate test). NO ANCHORS ANYWHERE IN THIS VERDICT.

=== 1. WHAT EXISTS (row identity first) ===
* OUR ENTRY = S1 ONLY: 12 rows, AniList 100408 (ONA, stored dates 2018-04-02 -> 2018-06-18 = the Amazon Prime advance regime), source = the ORIGINAL 蒼天の拳 (AniList 31148; N35 ruled 255 chapters). So S2 is absent from our catalog AND from our type source.
* S2 = AniList 102860 「蒼天の拳REGENESIS 2」, ONA, 12 episodes, PREQUEL edge to 100408. ja-WP numbers it CONTINUOUSLY inside one 各話リスト as 第2期 = eps 13-24: 13 神に選ばれし民 / 14 義兄への憧れ / 15 現実になった予言 / 16 ミガドルの雷 / 17 交わらぬ想い / 18 ナハシュの落日 / 19 散り逝く漢 / 20 霞拳心の道 / 21 死合う運命 / 22 受け継ぐ生き様 / 23 ひとりの少女 エリカ・アレント / 24 霞拳志郎と云う漢. The official site's story index carries the same 24 entries under 第1期 / 第2期 headings (independent title confirmation), and en-WP's list also runs 13-24. THREE DATE REGIMES for those rows: en-WP 2018-10-01 -> 2018-12-17 (Mondays - the same advance regime our stored S1 dates use), AniList 2018-10-02 -> 2018-12-18, ja-WP TOKYO MX 2018年10月9日 - 12月25日 (火曜 0:30 = Monday late night). Nothing proposed - we hold no S2 rows - but a future S2 entry must take the regime our S1 rows already use and confirm it with a second source.
* THE REGENESIS MANGA = AniList 107892 / MU 55727817104: 月刊コミックゼノン, ch 1 in the Dec-2017 issue, on sale 2017-10-25 - the SAME day the new anime was announced, in the SAME magazine issue (mantan-web, 2017-10-25: 「25日発売のマンガ誌「月刊コミックゼノン」12月号で発表された。同号では、マンガの新章「蒼天の拳 リジェネシス」の連載も始まった」). Hiatus from 2020-05 for 辻秀輝's illness; resumed in the 2025年1月号 (on sale 2024-11-25); completed 2025-09-25. Six volumes: 2018-03-20 / 2018-11-20 / 2019-07-20 / 2020-02-20 / 2025-07-18 / 2025-11-20. CHAPTER SPACE: MU latest_chapter 26, AniList 30, 6 volumes - a SEPARATE space from the original's 255 (N35). Coamix's own Zenon viewer exposes only the free-window chapters (第1話 奪われた希望の目録!!の巻, 第2話 激動の蘭印!!の巻, 第4話 守るための力!!の巻, 第5話 天の一族!!の巻, a 第23.5話 連載再開記念：総復習 recap and 第24話 強情な漢!!の巻), i.e. ~ch 1-23 before the hiatus and 24+ after; there is NO public full chapter index. STAFF: 原哲夫 原作 / 武論尊 監修 / 八津弘幸 脚本 / 辻秀輝 作画. The ANIME's シリーズ構成・脚本 is 尾崎悟史 (a different writer) and its 原作 credit in ja-WP's staff table is 漫画「蒼天の拳」（原哲夫 監修 武論尊） - the ORIGINAL - for the 2006 series and REGENESIS alike.

=== 2. THE ARC / DIRECTION TABLE (T21 direction; anime numbers are ja-WP's continuous 1-24) ===

| 9b-12 | the branch: Guise's burn marks, the Nahash, シャムラ, the German army's hostage trade, シメオン・ナギット, 天斗聖陰拳 named | NONE - not in the original's ch 1-255, not in the ReGenesis manga (whose story starts years later in the Dutch East Indies) | ANIME FIRST (ja-WP: 「コミック版に先駆けて新たな拳法「天斗聖陰拳」が登場する」) | anime-original bridge -> filler vs the instrument (ep 12 ruled T6; eps 10-11 proposed here) |

=== 3. WHY 'PARALLEL' AND NOT 'ADAPTATION' - the I40 boundary, both halves ===
(a) NEITHER TELLING ADAPTS THE OTHER. For eps 16-24 the manga's pages did not exist (vol 4 = 2020-02, then a 4.5-year hiatus; vols 5-6 = 2025) - an adaptation cannot precede its source by seven years. For eps 13-15 the manga's chapters DID exist (~ch 1-11 by Oct 2018, on a monthly schedule from 2017-10) but the anime rebuilds the situation rather than animating it, and Hara names the divergence: 「マンガでは成長したエリカが描かれるのですが、アニメーションでは以前のイメージで展開していきます」. ja-WP: 「内容は原作版の途中から分岐してアニメオリジナルストーリーに繋がる形となっており、コミック版に先駆けて新たな拳法「天斗聖陰拳」が登場する」. en-WP verbatim: 「Despite sharing the same title, Sōten no Ken: Re:Genesis is not a direct adaptation of the manga of the same name, but instead picks up from where the 2006 anime series left off and mixes plot elements from the unadapted latter half of the original Sōten no Ken manga and the ongoing Re:Genesis manga.」
(b) THE COMMON SOURCE IS UNCITABLE. 原哲夫 interview, on the ANIME's own official site (COAMIX): the anime project came first and the editors then proposed the manga (「数年前にアニメーションの新企画が上がった時に、編集部からマンガの方もやりませんかって話が出て、取り掛かろうと思いました」); he read the whole anime and 「特に、最初の導入の部分と最後のエンディングは力を入れましたね。導入部分は、ネームで割り直したりしました」 - he worked the anime's ENDING personally; 「その上で新たなエピソード（蒼天の拳リジェネシス）が入るということで、前作からの続きにして、マンガでの連載が始まりました。だからマンガとアニメのスタートが違うんです」; 「当たり前の事ですがマンガとアニメは別物です」; on the manga 「話の軸はもう決まっているので…マンガとしての『蒼天の拳リジェネシス』の世界観を再構成していきたい」; and on the ending 「どういう死に様にするかは、既に決めてあるので、死から逆算して話をくみあげているので問題ないはずです」. A pre-decided, unpublished spine (including the death) realized twice, in two media, by two teams under one author. hokuto.fandom, independently: 「The second half follows the same story outline as Re:Genesis manga (they were being made simultaneously), but depicted differently.」 The anime's own /comic page even sells the MANGA with the tagline 「霞拳志郎の命を賭した最期の闘いが、今、幕を開ける！」, which the official ep-13 synopsis reuses almost word for word (「拳志郎の命を賭した最後の闘いが、今まさに始まった――。」) - one story, two products.
WHAT WOULD REFUTE THIS: a source showing the anime's scripts worked from delivered manga ネーム, or any ReGenesis chapter published BEFORE the corresponding episode in the 16-24 block. Neither exists in anything reachable.

=== 4. HOW THIS DIFFERS FROM DBS (so the ruling is not over-read) ===
* DBS: two tellings of the SAME arcs in the same order, with the outline documented outside both (ja-WP / Kanzenshuu) and AniList's edge ALTERNATIVE. HERE: the shared material is the OPENING arc and the CLIMAX; the middles are largely disjoint (the anime relocates to Shanghai and Japan and KILLS Yasaka in ep 19; the manga stays in the Dutch East Indies with a cast - ハルト, バラオン, 天斗三人衆, 天斗巨神兵 - the anime never has). AniList's edges here are ADAPTATION in both directions, and 102860 carries ADAPTATION edges to BOTH manga (31148 and 107892), so a parallel ruling must name mangaAnilistId 107892 explicitly (I40 already requires the ruled id) or the picker can land on the original.
* If ruled parallel (T30/A46): correspondence would be ARC-grain and sparse - 13-15 divergent against the manga's opening arc, 16-19 anime_only/divergent, 20-24 divergent against vol 6 - and NO episode->chapter row is citable anywhere. No source in any language maps a REGENESIS episode to a リジェネシス chapter, and the manga's own chapter index is not fully public. A2/A46 completeness would therefore be honest dashes, not rows.

=== 5. WHAT OUR ENTRY OWES TODAY (eps 10-12) ===
Ep 10 (若き伝承者), official COAMIX synopsis: 羅門 and エリカ flee a government-army attack on the church cemetery into Shanghai's alleys; 羅門 fights as her 「小さな守護者」; the beast-like シャムラ charges; 玉玲 and 子英 escape machine-gun fire; a deeply hooded stranger appears before 田楽田 and 河馬超 (= 流緋鶴, whom ja-WP marks 「アニメにのみ登場する」). ja-WP also files 潘光琳's death 「アニメ版『REGENESIS』では、子英を中国政府軍の攻撃からかばって致命傷を負い」 as anime-only. Ep 11 (天斗聖陰拳): the GERMAN army demands Yasaka's 勾玉 and Erika in exchange for 羅門; Kenshiro goes alone to a ruined temple; シャムラ - 「ドイツ軍に身をやつしたシメオン一派」 - lets slip 「天斗聖陰拳」. NONE of this is in the original's ch 1-255 (whose line at this point is 190-195, the Du Tianfeng sea battle, and 196-243, the Liu Zongwu arc and 天授の儀 - never animated; wave 6 + Coamix's index), and none of it is in the ReGenesis manga. Both rows are filler under T27, the same class Sean already ruled for ep 12 (T6). Under A1 they take no anchor; under T28 no graft/partial tie is owed because no source pages are quoted - the tie is a `divergence`, the shape ep 12 already carries.

flags_for_sean: IDENTITY VERDICT (the ask's Q1), MEDIUM confidence: the anime REGENESIS S2 is a PARALLEL telling of the same continuation as the 蒼天の拳 リジェネシス manga, not an adaptation of it and not wholly anime-original. Both halves of I40 hold: neither telling adapts the other (eps 16-24 precede the manga's version of that climax by seven years; eps 13-15 restage rather than animate ch ~1-11), and the common source is uncitable (Hara on the anime's own site: the anime project came first, he worked its ENDING personally, 「マンガとアニメは別物」, 「話の軸はもう決まっている」, 「死に様は…既に決めてある…死から逆算して話をくみあげている」). It is WEAKER than DBS in one respect you should weigh: only the opening arc and the climax correspond - the middles are largely disjoint, and Yasaka dies in the anime while he is alive in the manga's 2025 volumes. My recommendation: rule the RELATION only if and when an S2 entry exists; nothing in our catalog depends on it today.

STRUCTURE (the ask's Q2): S2 IS NOT IN OUR CATALOG. Our entry = 12 rows = AniList 100408 (S1). AniList 102860 is a separate ONA (12 eps, PREQUEL edge to 100408); ja-WP and en-WP both number it 13-24 continuously. AFL has NO S2 page (three obvious slugs 404) and its 12-row list is exactly our rows, so an S2 entry would arrive with no AFL types at all. THREE OPTIONS, with consequences: (a) LEAVE IT OUT - today's state, honest, and the catalog says nothing false; (b) ADD S2 UNDER THE ORIGINAL MANGA (our current instrument) - then all 12 rows are FILLER (zero standing in ch 1-255) and the entry carries no positions by A1: honest but empty; (c) ADD S2 AS A PARALLEL SERIES against the ReGenesis manga (I40 source_relation=parallel, mangaAnilistId 107892 named explicitly because AniList carries ADAPTATION edges to BOTH manga) - then T30 standings apply and A46 correspondence is ARC-grain only, because NO source maps any episode to any リジェネシス chapter and the manga's chapter index is not fully public (MU 26 / AniList 30 chapters, 6 vols).

EPS 10-11 (the ask's Q3) - RETYPED FILLER, two sources each (official COAMIX per-episode synopses + ja-WP's character/school entries, cross-checked against en-WP and the ReGenesis manga's publisher blurbs). Note the one source that reads the other way: hokuto.fandom says 'the series' first half covers abridged, truncated versions of the Liu Feiyan and Yasaka arcs' - if 'first half' is read as eps 1-12 it would keep 10-12 canon, but the official synopses for 10, 11 and 12 refute it, and Sean has already ruled ep 12 filler on the same evidence.
